name: Grow Therapy Provider Platform
short_description: All-in-one provider platform combining insurance credentialing, billing, EHR, and client referrals for independent mental health therapists building insurance-based practices.
long_description: Grow Therapy is a comprehensive provider enablement platform designed to help mental health therapists build and scale insurance-based private practices. Founded in 2020 and headquartered in New York City, Grow Therapy has raised over $180 million in funding and serves thousands of therapists across all 50 states. Unlike platforms that only handle billing, Grow Therapy provides a complete practice management suite including insurance credentialing, claims submission, an integrated EHR system, scheduling, client matching, and a telehealth platform. The company is in-network with major insurance carriers including Aetna, Cigna, UnitedHealthcare, Anthem, and various Blue Cross Blue Shield plans. Providers maintain independence as contractors while Grow Therapy eliminates the administrative complexity of insurance-based practice. Therapists typically see net session rates of $90-150+ depending on license type, location, and payer, with Grow Therapy taking a percentage fee (approximately 10-15%) from reimbursements. The platform's client matching system actively connects patients seeking therapy with available providers based on specialty, availability, and preferences. Grow Therapy differentiates itself by including EHR/documentation tools, making it more of a complete practice solution compared to billing-only platforms.
one_liner: Complete practice platform with credentialing, billing, EHR, and client referrals for insurance-based therapists.

faqs.q: How much do Grow Therapy therapists make per session?
faqs.a: Grow Therapy providers typically receive $90-150+ per session net after the platform fee. Actual rates depend on your license type, geographic location, insurance payer, and session codes. Payment is processed via weekly direct deposit. The platform fee covers credentialing, billing, EHR, and client referrals.

faqs.q: What does Grow Therapy include vs Headway?
faqs.a: Grow Therapy provides a more comprehensive solution including integrated EHR/documentation tools, whereas Headway focuses primarily on credentialing and billing. Both handle insurance paneling, claims submission, and client referrals. Grow Therapy's all-in-one approach means you don't need a separate EHR subscription.

faqs.q: How long does Grow Therapy credentialing take?
faqs.a: Insurance credentialing through Grow Therapy typically takes 4-8 weeks depending on the insurance panels and your state. Grow Therapy handles all paperwork and follow-up. You can use their EHR and telehealth platform immediately while waiting for insurance credentialing to complete.

faqs.q: Is Grow Therapy better than going independent?
faqs.a: Grow Therapy is ideal for therapists who want insurance-based income without administrative burden. The platform fee (10-15%) covers credentialing, billing, EHR, telehealth, and client referrals. Independent practice gives you higher per-session revenue but requires managing billing, credentialing, marketing, and software subscriptions yourself.
